_schema._general: Fighting Style is a pick-one-of-N choice bundled into the class table as a single named feature ('Fighting Style' / 'fighter-fighting-style' etc.) rather than one features_by_level entry per option — structurally the same problem Pact Boon solves (see pact-boons.json), just with a class-specific option list instead of one shared across a class. Granted at Fighter 1st, Paladin 2nd, Ranger 2nd (per each class's features_by_level). Real RAW: never re-chosen after being picked (no swap), matching Pact Boon's precedent — though Tasha's Cauldron's optional Martial Versatility feature (an ASI-level swap) exists on top of this; see TODO.md.
_schema.id: Same id used in engine/data/feature-catalog.json and the SRD cache's own `index` (src/data/api_data_cache/features.json) — see invocations.json's schema note for why. Paladin's variant ids intentionally have no 'paladin-' prefix ('fighting-style-defense', not 'paladin-fighting-style-defense') because that's how they're already keyed in the SRD cache — matched rather than renamed to avoid a duplicate/orphaned id. The 5 TCE additions shared across multiple classes follow the same no-prefix convention (they're not in the SRD cache at all — added to src/data/published_features.json instead); the 2 class-exclusive ones (Superior Technique, Blessed Warrior, Druidic Warrior) get a class prefix since nothing else references them.
_schema.found: 2026-09-09 — discovered via a real bug report: the New Character Tool lists 'Fighting Style' under Spells & Features for Fighter/Paladin/Ranger but has no way to actually choose one, because the engine never emitted a pendingChoice for it. Fixed alongside this file.
_schema.tce_additions: Added 2026-09-17, per project owner's call to use every official 2014-ruleset WotC book during R&D (see TODO.md). Real correction along the way: this project's own TODO previously said TCE added '5' new fighting styles — it actually added 7. 5 are general options (Blind Fighting: Fighter/Paladin/Ranger; Interception: Fighter/Paladin; Superior Technique: Fighter only; Thrown Weapon Fighting: Fighter/Ranger; Unarmed Fighting: Fighter/Ranger), verified against 2 independent sources (a Superior Technique detail — the superiority die is a d6, not a d4 as one source first suggested — needed a 2nd source to resolve, per this project's cross-check standard). The other 2 are single-class-exclusive cantrip-granting styles that replace the general options entirely for that class's own flavor: Blessed Warrior (Paladin only, 2 Cleric cantrips) and Druidic Warrior (Ranger only, 2 Druid cantrips) — neither is available to any other class, not even via the Fighting Initiate feat.
